name: Unshaken Brace
description: Take the first rank stance of the order and let a heavy blow break on a body that does not tremble.

name: Staunch Knuckle
description: Throw the order's plain fist from a braced stance with the shoulder locked behind it.

name: Resolve Pulse
description: Feel the pulse of resolve in the rank and know where it runs strong and where it runs thin.

name: Staunch Mending
description: Draw fear and shock out of a comrade one at a time down the rank until all of them stand steady.

name: Bracing Presence
description: Stand close to a comrade and let the user's calm bearing steady the comrade's breath and aim.

name: Staunch Counter
description: Take the foe's blow on the braced frame and answer it with a strike that breaks the foe's footing.

name: Unshaken Mantle
description: Spread an unshaken mantle across the rank that turns blows and feeds each comrade steadiness.

name: Staunch Charge
description: Break from the rank in a straight unshakable charge and strike at its end with the order's whole weight.

name: Unshaken Return
description: Take a crushing blow into the unshaken will and send its full force back through a single answering stroke.

name: Skysworn Resolve
description: The order's closing move that wraps the whole rank in one unbroken calm whose depth grows with the user's reserve.

name: Resolute Stance
description: Take the rite's opening stance and meet each blow with the same level resolve.

name: Valiant Fist
description: Hit straight and hard at the foe's centre as the rite's first lesson in valour.

name: Valor Gauge
description: Gauge how much valour the user and the comrades have left to spend before the rite is done.

name: Resolute Easing
description: Wipe despair from the mind of a comrade with a slow firm pass of the hand.

name: Valiant Word
description: Speak the rite's brief word of valour and raise a comrade's courage to the user's own.

name: Resolute Blow
description: Deliver a measured blow that carries the full resolve of the rite behind the fist.

name: Valiant Parry
description: Turn a strike off the body with an open hand and step into the space it leaves.

name: Resolute Surge
description: Surge forward on the rite's rising count and break the foe's guard in a single drive.

name: Valiant Aegis
description: Meet a terror-aura with the rite's valiant calm until the aura's hold on the user fails.

name: Valiant Recoil
description: Swallow a mighty blow into the rite's valour and loose it again in one heavy answering stroke.

name: Resolute Rite
description: The rite's closing move that bows the will of the foe under the weight of the user's own with a force that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Poised Stance
description: Hold the school's balanced stance whose weight rides evenly through a blow.

name: Sapphire Fist
description: Throw a cold clean fist that carries no heat of anger.

name: Poise Reading
description: Read who in the line holds poise and who only wears it as a mask.

name: Poised Mending
description: Smooth the ragged nerves of a comrade until the comrade's breathing and aim return to poise.

name: Sapphire Lend
description: Lend a comrade a share of the school's cold clearness through a hand laid on the back.

name: Poised Counter
description: Wait out a rush in perfect balance and answer it with one blow at the foe's weakest line.

name: Sapphire Screen
description: Hold a cold clear ward of will before the line that no hot word or hard blow can warm.

name: Poised Drive
description: Drive forward from perfect balance with a blow that cannot be sidestepped.

name: Poised Return
description: Take the whole weight of a charge into the poised will and send it back as one clean stroke.

name: Sapphire Heart
description: The school's closing move that fills the line with a cold unbreakable clarity whose reach grows with the user's reserve.

name: Exalted Stance
description: Rise into the discipline's tall stance and let the force of a blow pass down the straight line of the body.

name: Exalted Fist
description: Strike with a fist lifted above doubt and fear so the blow arrives exactly as the mind drew it.

name: Exalted Gauge
description: Gauge how high the will of a person stands and how much weight it can still bear.

name: Zenith Gait
description: Cover the ground at a pace that never hurries and never falls behind.

name: Exalted Cleansing
description: Cleanse an ally of a binding of dread with a long even pour of clear will.

name: Zenith Word
description: Speak from the height of the discipline and let the word set an ally's resolve upright.

name: Exalted Counter
description: Cut across the foe's attack with a counter that breaks its rhythm and its aim.

name: Zenith Screen
description: Stand under a ward raised from the height of the Core so that the pressure above cannot reach the body.

name: Exalted Drive
description: Bring the Core's weight into a drive that passes through guard and stance alike.

name: Zenith Revival
description: Pull back a comrade whose breath has just failed by anchoring the comrade's heart to the user's own; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Zenith Reversal
description: Take the pressure of a mighty foe into the Core and turn it back on that foe in one reversing stroke.

name: Zenith Resolve
description: The discipline's closing move that lifts every ally to the user's height and presses every foe beneath it with a weight set by the user's reserve.

name: Tenacious Brace
description: Brace the body low and wide against a gale of blows and refuse to be moved.

name: Gale Knuckle
description: Hit with a knuckle driven by the whole lean of the body into the wind.

name: Gale Sense
description: Sense the shift of pressure in a fight the way a sailor senses a change in the wind.

name: Tenacious Mending
description: Draw the sting of exhaustion and despair out of a comrade with a patient stubborn touch.

name: Gale Rousing
description: Rouse a comrade with a rough cry that blows the cobwebs from the comrade's will.

name: Tenacious Blow
description: Throw a blow that refuses to be turned and returns at once if it is.

name: Gale Shrug
description: Shrug a crushing aura off the shoulders as a sailor shrugs spray.

name: Tenacious Drive
description: Drive the whole stubborn weight of the body through the foe in a single advance.

name: Gale Cloak
description: Throw a mantle of will over the nearest comrades that shelters them from the blows and feeds their staying power.

name: Tenacious Return
description: Soak up the weight of a long barrage and let it out again in one hard return.

name: Gale Heart
description: The school's closing move that sets a standing gale of will round the whole company whose strength rises with the user's reserve.

name: Undaunted Stance
description: Take a forward leaning stance as one who has chosen to go on and cannot be stopped by what lies ahead.

name: Windbound Fist
description: Throw a fist that follows the wind and cannot be stopped from landing where it was sent.

name: Undaunted Gauge
description: Gauge who in the company is still undaunted and who has begun to turn back.

name: Windbound Mending
description: Blow the fear out of a comrade's chest with a long steady breath of will.

name: Undaunted Word
description: Say the school's short word of going on and the comrade who hears it takes the next step.

name: Windbound Counter
description: Ride the foe's blow with the wind and strike back as the blow loses its strength.

name: Undaunted Ward
description: Hold an undaunted ward before the user that grows firmer the harder it is pressed.

name: Windbound Surge
description: Surge across the ground with the wind at the back and strike on arrival.

name: Undaunted Recoil
description: Meet a shattering blow with an undaunted breast and throw its force back as a single stroke.

name: Windbound Heart
description: The school's closing move that sends the whole company forward on one great gust of resolve with a strength that scales with the user's reserve.

name: Indomitable Stance
description: Stand as one who has weathered every storm before and expects to weather this one.

name: Storm Fist
description: Throw a fist that carries the pent-up charge of a storm held in the chest.

name: Indomitable Gauge
description: Gauge the stubbornness of a foe and learn how long the foe will fight on.

name: Storm Pace
description: Hold a dogged pace through the rise and fall of a storm of blows.

name: Indomitable Mending
description: Mend the shattered nerve of a comrade who has been through too much with a long even stream of will.

name: Storm Lend
description: Lend a comrade a measure of the user's storm-tested will until the comrade's own steadies.

name: Indomitable Blow
description: Deliver a blow that cannot be reasoned out of landing.

name: Storm Shrug
description: Shrug off a crushing aura or a bowing command as if it were only a squall.

name: Indomitable Surge
description: Surge through a barrage and strike the one who cast it.

name: Storm Revival
description: Bring a fallen comrade back across the line by lending the comrade's stopped heart the user's own storm-tested beat; the window is short and every use is a heavy consequence.

name: Indomitable Return
description: Gather the force of the foe's finest blow into the will and answer it with one that is finer still.

name: Storm Heart
description: The school's closing move that breaks the foe's line with a storm of will and floods the allies behind it with the same at a strength set by the user's reserve.

name: Unconquered Stance
description: Hold the stance of one who has not been beaten and does not mean to be.

name: Tempest Knuckle
description: Throw a wild bracing fist that gathers force from the pressure laid on the user.

name: Unconquered Gauge
description: Gauge how near a foe stands to breaking and how near the user stands to rising.

name: Tempest Easing
description: Burn the dross of terror and despair out of a comrade in a slow cleansing heat of will.

name: Unconquered Word
description: Say a word that has never been beaten and let a comrade lean on its weight.

name: Tempest Counter
description: Meet a blow in a swirl of will and return a counter that breaks the foe's rhythm.

name: Unconquered Aegis
description: Raise an aegis of unbeaten will that grows thicker with every blow it has already turned.

name: Tempest Surge
description: Gather the swirl of the fight into the fist and release it all at the foe's guard.

name: Unconquered Recoil
description: Take a mighty blow into the unconquered will and loose it in a single returning stroke.

name: Tempest Heart
description: The school's closing move that lets the pressure of the whole fight break at once in a tempest of will whose depth grows with the user's reserve.
